# gh fixtures

`2.101.0/pr-view.json` has the shape `gh pr view --json number,title,url,state,isDraft,statusCheckRollup` printed with **gh 2.101.0** for a real pull request, with the repository, names, ids and times replaced. `statusCheckRollup` mixes `CheckRun` items (a GitHub Actions job: `status`, `conclusion`, `detailsUrl`, `workflowName`) and `StatusContext` items (a commit status set by an app: `state`, `targetUrl`, which can be empty). The same check can be listed more than once, for example after it ran again; `gh pr checks` keeps the one started last, and so does cornercase, so the fixture lists `tests (ubuntu-24.04)` twice. A job still running has an empty `conclusion` and a zero `completedAt`.
